C0346.title: Couple Falsely Registered for Civil Service Exams 758 Times, Court Convicts
C0346.summary: During a provincial civil service exam registration period, a couple stole others' identity card information and falsely registered for the exam 758 times, creating the illusion of high applicant numbers to deter competitors. The act violated personal information laws, and the court later sentenced them.
